new_components.name: truncated_series_ends_midway
new_components.evidence: In Panels C and D the 'June 2025 projections' red line stops in early 2026 while others run to 2027
new_components.why_it_matters: 读值时必须确认某一时点是否存在该系列的点，否则会把三条线在同一横坐标全部填值，产生虚假数据。

new_components.name: overlapping_identical_series
new_components.evidence: In Panel D the green and blue lines coincide from 2026 onward, drawn as one visible trace
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一像素轨迹对应两个系列，单点读数无法区分September与December预测，需按重合处理。

new_components.name: stack_segment_gap_between_bars
new_components.evidence: Panel B bars separated by thin white gaps with no axis line between year groups
new_components.why_it_matters: 分段极薄（如0.1-0.2 % pts）时段边界与柱间空隙易混淆，影响薄层取值。

difficulty_notes: 最难在于读数精度：全图无任何数值标注，Panel B 刻度间距为 0.5 % pts，而待查值中 0.4、0.2、0.1 这类薄层只有约 4-8 像素高，5% 容差意味着 0.1 需读到 ±0.005 % pts，远超像素分辨；Latin America 与 OECD Asia-Pacific 的窄带甚至与柱间白缝混淆。Panel A 刻度间距 1 个百分点，要把 3.3 与 1.7 读到 ±0.17 与 ±0.09 也接近像素极限；Panel C/D 起点在 2.50 与 2.0 之上，进一步压缩了纵向可比性。标签方面每个值只需 3 个键（面板名+系列名+年份），相对容易。
